primitives.name: Canonical Brandbook Construction
primitives.verbatim_quote: # Brandbook Create the canonical Brandbook only after logo, palette, and typography are each approved.
primitives.assumptions: All branding elements must be pre-approved and stored in durable local state.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Failure occurs if any required element (logo, palette, typography) is unapproved or missing.

layer2.mapping: Brandbook generation mirrors a functional programming pipeline where inputs are validated before transformation into a fixed-output format.
layer2.telemetry: Completion of build process with all assets present and compliant.

primitives.name: Fixed Template Layout Contract
primitives.verbatim_quote: ## Fixed seven-slide structure Preserve the template's slide size, masters, layout, margins, grids, text positions, image zones, hierarchy, font sizes, spacing, crop, rotation, and stacking order except for these conditional rules.
primitives.assumptions: Template integrity is preserved through strict adherence to layout specifications.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Violation leads to non-compliance with brandbook standards.

layer2.mapping: Layout kernel defines spatial constraints and formatting rules that govern slide composition.
layer2.telemetry: Slide alignment and grid consistency verified via automated checks.

primitives.name: Mockup Conditional Placement
primitives.verbatim_quote: Mockup conditions: - no approved mockups: remove slide 7 - one: keep the first zone and remove the second - two: keep one mockup slide - more than two: duplicate the exact mockup slide for each additional pair Never place generated-but-unapproved work in the Brandbook.
primitives.assumptions: Mockup placement logic follows a deterministic rule set based on quantity of approved assets.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Non-compliance arises from placing unapproved or improperly duplicated mockups.

layer2.mapping: Conditional mockup placement mirrors a branching control flow in software design, enforcing discrete states based on input count.
layer2.telemetry: Number of mockup slides matches expected count derived from approved asset inventory.
